title: Dissipative structures in compressible inviscid fluids
summary: This note aims at the following problem. In an ideal density dependent fluid system, is the total energy dissipated on shock type discontinuities? To this end, we study the local energy balance for weak solutions to the isentropic compressible Euler system and derive fine properties of the defect measure. This is done by a careful analysis of the small scale properties of the solutions at the shock discontinuity.
